Question B-001-009-005.

Why the correct answer is right: A control operator is required whenever the station is transmitting.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "A control operator is not needed": A transmitting station requires a control operator.
- sourceIndex 2: "Whenever the station receiver is operated": Receiving alone is outside the control-operator trigger; transmitting is the trigger.
- sourceIndex 3: "Only when training another amateur radio operator": Training is not the only time a control operator is needed; transmitting is the key condition.
